title: On the Creation of Object-Centric Event Logs from Patient Journeys
abstract: arXiv:2611.33074v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interactions between patients and health systems as well as conditions that individuals experience during a disease are represented in patient journeys. Therefore, patient journeys are important assets to investigate how care is being provided, and how health systems can be designed to better suit the needs of patients. While there is initial work on patient journeys from a process mining perspective with traditional case notions, object-centric process mining techniques have yet to be covered. This is unfortunate, since due to the rich structure of objects and their relationships, object-centric process mining approaches are particularly promising in this context. This paper addresses this gap by investigating object-centric event log (OCEL) generation from patient journeys. translated_title: 从患者旅程中创建以对象为中心的事件日志
translated_abstract: 患者与医疗系统之间的互动以及个体在患病期间所经历的状况都被记录在患者旅程中。因此，患者旅程是研究医疗服务如何提供、以及如何设计医疗系统以更好地满足患者需求的重要资产。目前已有从传统案例概念的流程挖掘视角对患者旅程进行的初步研究，但以对象为中心的流程挖掘技术尚未被涉及。这令人遗憾，因为得益于对象及其关系的丰富结构，以对象为中心的流程挖掘方法在这一领域尤其具有前景。本文通过研究从患者旅程生成以对象为中心的事件日志（OCEL）来填补这一空白。基于一系列挑战和需求的清单，本文提出了一种从患者旅程数据创建OCEL的方法，并在……上对该方法进行了评估。
tldr: 本文针对医疗领域中对象中心流程挖掘研究的空白，基于一系列挑战与需求提出了一种从患者旅程数据创建以对象为中心的事件日志（OCEL）的方法。
en_tdlr: This paper addresses the gap in object-centric process mining for healthcare by proposing an approach to create object-centric event logs (OCELs) from patient journey data, based on a set of identified challenges and requirements.
